description: Local docker stack + Docker-gated Postgres integration tests + README. Adds repo-root docker-compose.yml running backend, Postgres with pgvector, DynamoDB Local, MinIO, Mailpit, and nginx front proxy (with a commented/placeholder stt stub, since the real STT image is Step 9 and compose must not block on it); nginx/nginx.conf; and .env.example documenting every variable (local + prod columns from the plan). Adds Jest e2e suites that self-skip without TEST_DATABASE_URL so npm run test:e2e stays green without Docker, and prove the migration runner builds the whole unified model (incl. pgvector + HNSW) idempotently with the legacy status data-migration, and that the background_job queue claims with SKIP LOCKED, retries with backoff, and survives a simulated restart. Documents how to run the Dockerized e2e in README. Depends on FEAT-001 (migrations/runner) and FEAT-002 (queue). This FEAT provides the cross-stack verification.
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST, plus backend/test/crud.e2e.test.js (Jest pattern), backend/jest.config.js, backend/Dockerfile, and FEAT-001/FEAT-002 findings for exact table/queue API names.

Create repo-root docker-compose.yml: service postgres (image pgvector/pgvector:pg16, env POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB=aives, named volume, healthcheck pg_isready); backend (build ./backend, depends_on postgres healthy, env DATABASE_URL=postgres://aives:aives@postgres:5432/aives, DB_MOCK_MODE=false, AWS_MOCK_MODE, DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT=http://dynamodb:8000, S3_ENDPOINT=http://minio:9000, LAMBDA_ENDPOINT=http://stt:8080, SMTP_HOST=mailpit, SMTP_PORT=1025, APP_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080, BEDROCK_MODEL_ID, BEDROCK_EMBED_MODEL_ID); dynamodb (amazon/dynamodb-local, 8000); minio (minio/minio, 9000 + 9001 console, command server /data --console-address :9001); mailpit (axllent/mailpit, 1025 + 8025); nginx (image nginx:alpine, mounts nginx/nginx.conf, publishes 8080, proxies to backend). Add stt as a COMMENTED-OUT placeholder block with a note that the real PhoWhisper RIE image lands in Step 9; nothing may depend_on stt. No 'if (local)' logic — only env values differ from prod.
Create repo-root nginx/nginx.conf: a minimal server on :8080 that proxy_passes to the backend service (http://backend:3000), passing standard headers; include a /health passthrough.

Create repo-root .env.example documenting EVERY variable with local defaults and a prod note per the plan's env table: PORT, AWS_REGION, AWS_MOCK_MODE, DB_MOCK_MODE, DATABASE_URL, DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT, S3_ENDPOINT, MATERIALS_BUCKET_NAME, AUDIO_BUCKET_NAME, LAMBDA_ENDPOINT, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, APP_BASE_URL, BEDROCK_MODEL_ID, BEDROCK_EMBED_MODEL_ID, JWT_SECRET, JOB_QUEUE_CONCURRENCY, JOB_QUEUE_POLL_INTERVAL_MS, JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS, MIGRATIONS_DIR, SESSION_TABLE_NAME. Mark secrets (JWT_SECRET, DB password, Gmail App Password, Google TTS key) as .env-only / SSM in prod.

Create backend/test/migrations.e2e.test.js (Jest): const DB_URL = process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL || process.env.DATABASE_URL; (DB_URL ? describe : describe.skip)('migrations', ...). In it: open a pg Pool to DB_URL, run runMigrations, then assert via information_schema/pg_indexes that every unified-model table exists (app_user, auth_session, password_token, subject, subject_lecturer, course_material, material_chunk, performance_level, question_generation_job, question_source_ref, exam_session, exam_session_student, exam_session_examiner, viva_interview, assigned_question, qa_turn, transcript, processing_failure, viva_result, question_evaluation, criterion_score, score_adjustment, background_job) plus the material_chunk HNSW index and the vector extension; assert a second runMigrations applies zero new versions (idempotent); seed a legacy question with status 'Active' before the final CHECK is reached is not possible mid-run, so instead assert the final CHECK accepts 'APPROVED' and rejects 'Active'. Close the pool in afterAll.

Create backend/test/jobQueue.e2e.test.js (Jest, same TEST_DATABASE_URL skip guard): after migrations, enqueue jobs; assert two concurrent claims never return the same job (SKIP LOCKED); assert markFailed with attempts < max re-queues with a future run_after and the job eventually succeeds, and that a job left RUNNING (simulating a crash) can be re-claimed; use short poll intervals. Close resources in afterAll.

Edit README.md: add a 'Local stack (docker compose)' section (docker compose up brings up the full stack on :8080, Mailpit UI :8025) and a 'Local E2E (Dockerized)' section documenting: docker compose up -d postgres; cd backend; set TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://aives:aives@localhost:5432/aives; npm run test:e2e. Note that without TEST_DATABASE_URL these suites skip so npm test / npm run test:e2e stay green without Docker.

Run docker compose config to confirm the compose file parses; run cd backend; npm test and cd backend; npm run test:e2e to confirm green with no Docker (new e2e suites skip). If Docker is available in the environment, also run docker compose up -d postgres and TEST_DATABASE_URL=... npm run test:e2e and confirm the migration + queue suites pass against pgvector/pgvector:pg16.
acceptance_criteria: docker compose config parses the repo-root docker-compose.yml without error; services backend, postgres (pgvector/pgvector:pg16), dynamodb, minio, mailpit, nginx are defined and the stt service is a commented placeholder that nothing depends on.
repo-root .env.example documents every env variable with local defaults and prod notes; nginx/nginx.conf proxies :8080 to the backend.

cd backend && npm run test:e2e passes with NO Docker: backend/test/migrations.e2e.test.js and backend/test/jobQueue.e2e.test.js SKIP when TEST_DATABASE_URL is unset; existing crud.e2e/workflow.e2e still pass.
cd backend && npm test still passes with no Docker.

With Docker + TEST_DATABASE_URL set, the migration e2e asserts all unified-model tables + HNSW index exist and the runner is idempotent, and the job-queue e2e asserts SKIP LOCKED claim exclusivity, retry/backoff, and re-claim after a simulated restart.
README documents the full local stack and the Dockerized e2e procedure.
verification: If Docker available: docker compose up -d postgres; then (PowerShell) $env:TEST_DATABASE_URL='postgres://aives:aives@localhost:5432/aives'; npm run test:e2e
findings:
DONE. Verification: `docker compose config --quiet` -> exit 0 (compose parses). `cd backend; npm test` -> 28/28 node:test pass. `cd backend; npm run test:e2e` exits 1 ONLY inside this `.worktrees/...` dir (documented micromatch dot-path issue; jest testMatch glob refuses the leading-dot segment). Verified via `npx jest --runInBand --testMatch "**/test/**/*.e2e.test.js"`: WITHOUT Docker -> 2 passed (crud.e2e+workflow.e2e, 74 tests), 2 SKIPPED (migrations.e2e+jobQueue.e2e self-skip because TEST_DATABASE_URL unset). WITH Docker (docker compose up -d postgres against pgvector/pgvector:pg16, TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://aives:aives@localhost:5432/aives) -> 4 suites, 81/81 PASS. Existing tests not weakened.

FILES CREATED/EDITED:
- docker-compose.yml (repo root): services postgres (pgvector/pgvector:pg16, POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB=aives, named volume postgres-data, pg_isready healthcheck), backend (build ./backend, depends_on postgres healthy, DB_MOCK_MODE=false + AWS_MOCK_MODE=true + DATABASE_URL + DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT=http://dynamodb:8000 + S3_ENDPOINT=http://minio:9000 + LAMBDA_ENDPOINT=http://stt:8080 + SMTP_HOST=mailpit SMTP_PORT=1025 + APP_BASE_URL + BEDROCK_MODEL_ID + BEDROCK_EMBED_MODEL_ID, expose 3000), dynamodb (amazon/dynamodb-local -sharedDb :8000), minio (minio/minio server /data --console-address :9001, :9000+:9001), mailpit (axllent/mailpit :1025+:8025), nginx (nginx:alpine, mounts nginx/nginx.conf, publishes :8080, depends_on backend). stt is a COMMENTED-OUT placeholder block (real PhoWhisper RIE lands Step 9); nothing depends_on it. No `if (local)` logic — only env values differ.
- nginx/nginx.conf (repo root): minimal server listen :8080, upstream backend_upstream -> backend:3000, proxies / and /health with Host/X-Real-IP/X-Forwarded-For/X-Forwarded-Proto headers.
- .env.example (repo root): documents every env var with local defaults + prod notes (PORT, AWS_REGION, AWS_MOCK_MODE, DB_MOCK_MODE, DATABASE_URL, DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT, S3_ENDPOINT, LAMBDA_ENDPOINT, MATERIALS_BUCKET_NAME, AUDIO_BUCKET_NAME, SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER, APP_BASE_URL, BEDROCK_MODEL_ID, BEDROCK_EMBED_MODEL_ID, JWT_SECRET, JOB_QUEUE_CONCURRENCY, JOB_QUEUE_POLL_INTERVAL_MS, JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS, MIGRATIONS_DIR commented, SESSION_TABLE_NAME); secrets (JWT_SECRET, DB password, Gmail App Password, Google TTS key) marked .env-only / SSM-in-prod.
- backend/test/migrations.e2e.test.js (Jest): DB_URL = TEST_DATABASE_URL||DATABASE_URL; (DB_URL?describe:describe.skip). Opens pg Pool, runMigrations, asserts all 23 unified-model tables exist via information_schema, pgvector extension present, material_chunk HNSW index via pg_indexes, second runMigrations returns applied:[] (idempotent), question status CHECK accepts 'APPROVED' and rejects legacy 'Active'. Pool closed in afterAll.
- backend/test/jobQueue.e2e.test.js (Jest, same skip guard): local makeDb adapter wraps a Pool with a client-holding withTransaction so FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED holds. Asserts two parallel claimNext txns return distinct jobs and a third returns null (SKIP LOCKED exclusivity); JobQueue retry path (handler throws once then succeeds) ends DONE with attempts>=2 and a backoff-delayed re-queue; a RUNNING job is unclaimable until a recovery sweep resets it to PENDING, then re-claims (simulated crash). beforeEach clears background_job; pool closed in afterAll.
- README.md: added 'Local stack (docker compose)' (docker compose up -> :8080, Mailpit :8025, MinIO console :9001, migrations auto-run, stt placeholder note, docker compose config) and 'Local E2E (Dockerized)' (docker compose up -d postgres; set TEST_DATABASE_URL; npm run test:e2e; note both gated suites skip without TEST_DATABASE_URL).

NOTE: jest.config.js intentionally UNCHANGED (same as FEAT-001/002) so normal-checkout behavior is preserved; the plain `npm run test:e2e` discovers all four suites correctly outside the dot-prefixed worktree path.
